questions.answer: It was difficult, but okay.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: I stayed across the border, in Annemasse, France. I would recommend this as it only took ~35 minutes to commute in to school each day and I saved some money rather than staying in the city centre of Geneva. There was a significant fare, however, to take the train into the city each day (~5 euro each direction).

Additional comments:
questions.answer: I really enjoyed the diversity of speakers, topics, and lectures during this program. It offered a broad perspective on the topics of microplastic and demonstrated the interdisciplinary collaborations required to address concerns.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *

questions.answer: Being in a very busy routine. Every day was long and intense and not as much free time as I anticipated, but I still very much enjoyed my experience in Geneva.
